title: Riot Announces New Date for Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
author: Na
description: Riot Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: RIOT) announced the rescheduling of its second quarter 2026 earnings conference call to Monday, August 10, 2026, at 4:30 P.M. EST. The call will be available via webcast and dial-in options for investors and analysts to discuss the company's financial performance.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article is a routine announcement of a rescheduled earnings call with no indication of positive or negative business developments. The rescheduling itself is a procedural matter that does not convey material information about company performance or outlook.

title: Stock Market Today, June 26: Keel Infrastructure Rises as Convertible Financing Backs AI Data Center Push
author: Eric Trie
description: Keel Infrastructure rose 2.47% to $6.01 following a $458 million convertible-note financing to fund AI data-center expansion. The company, rebranded from Bitfarms, faces the challenge of converting power-secured sites into signed customer leases to demonstrate clear project economics. Peers CleanSpark and Riot Platforms also gained ground in the digital infrastructure sector.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the stock rose on financing news, the article emphasizes execution risks. The $458M convertible provides financial flexibility, but long-term value depends on converting power-secured sites into signed leases and demonstrating viable project economics, which remains uncertain.
Stock gained 2.90% alongside sector strength in digital infrastructure for AI/HPC workloads, indicating positive investor sentiment in the competitive landscape.

title: Stock Market Today, June 1: HIVE Digital Rises Ahead of Results as Analyst Backs AI Data Center Push
author: Eric Trie
description: HIVE Digital Technologies stock rose 5.31% to $4.76 on June 1st following analyst price target increases and ahead of upcoming earnings. Cantor Fitzgerald raised its price target to $4.60 from $3.00, citing the company's renewable-powered Bitcoin mining operations and expansion plans into AI and high-performance computing data centers. The upcoming earnings call will provide details on mining profitability, power capacity, and progress on AI/HPC initiatives.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock gained 5.31% on analyst price target increase from $3.00 to $4.60 by Cantor Fitzgerald. Positive momentum driven by recognition of company's renewable energy access, Bitcoin mining operations, and strategic expansion into AI and high-performance computing data centers.
Stock rose 3.27% as investors tracked sector demand and capacity expansions within the cryptocurrency mining industry, benefiting from positive sentiment in the broader mining sector.

title: Stock Market Today, May 11: Iren Falls After $2 Billion Convertible Notes Offering Pressures Shares
author: Howard Smith
description: Iren shares fell 9.89% to $55.15 after announcing a $2 billion convertible notes offering, which sparked concerns about shareholder dilution. The decline comes despite last week's positive Nvidia partnership announcement, as investors also weighed a recent earnings miss and the company's transition from Bitcoin mining to AI cloud services.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock fell 9.89% due to $2 billion convertible notes offering causing dilution concerns, combined with recent fiscal Q3 earnings miss and sequential revenue decrease during transition from Bitcoin mining to AI services.
Stock gained 1.9% and benefited from positive sentiment around its multi-year partnership with Iren for AI infrastructure cloud services, demonstrating strong demand for AI-related services.
Stock gained 5.23% as investors weighed crypto exposure positively in the market environment.

title: Stock Market Today, May 5: Cipher Digital Surges on AI Data Center Shift Backed by Hyperscale Leases
author: Eric Trie
description: Cipher Mining (CIFR) surged 23.53% on May 5, 2026, despite weak Q1 results, driven by a strategic pivot toward AI and high-performance computing data centers. The company secured a new $200 million credit facility and announced approximately $11.4 billion in contracted revenue, signaling a shift from bitcoin mining to data center infrastructure.
